entries.claim: A hostage's AI stack holds four states, by the original's ids: 0x17 CAiSHostage, 9 CAiSFollow, 0x11 CAiSRescued, 2 CAiSHold; online it spawns into 0x17 at sub-state 3 in the escortee unit 0x11 with its compass anchor.

tests.name: spawned online a hostage enters 0x17 sub-state 3 standing (FUN_00573130 D:L434903-434915), after 2 s sub-state 2 crouching after 0.25 + U(0, 0.95) s (STANCE_DELAY_READING, FUN_00563100 D:L427285), after 5 more sub-state 5 (HOSTAGE_TIMERS_READING; FUN_00601910 D:L511764-511910)

the stack moves as the original's (199 §1): push 9 over 0x17 suspends it; replace 0x11 over 9 ends 9; unwindTo 0x17 pops 0x11; a push equal to the top is refused (FUN_005f5cd0 D:L505625-505626); a dead body refuses every push; clear(force = 0) on a living hostage pops nothing

entries.claim: CAiSHostage's Tick online: sub-state 3 asks RESTRAINED and, in unit 0x11, stands at once and after 2 s enters 2; 2 asks the crouch with the default stance delay 0.25 + U(0, 0.95) s and after 5 s enters 5, where it stays watching.

tests.name: spawned online a hostage enters 0x17 sub-state 3 standing (FUN_00573130 D:L434903-434915), after 2 s sub-state 2 crouching after 0.25 + U(0, 0.95) s (STANCE_DELAY_READING, FUN_00563100 D:L427285), after 5 more sub-state 5 (HOSTAGE_TIMERS_READING; FUN_00601910 D:L511764-511910)

entries.claim: CAiSHostage's timers are 2 s (3 -> 2), 5 s (2 -> 5), 10 s (1 -> 5 and 6 -> 5) and 0.5 s (3 -> 4), counted down by the frame dt; while one runs the Tick does nothing else and the frame it runs out runs the next sub-state's case.

entries.claim: In sub-state 5 the watch runs on every frame of a 0.1 s window every 5 s of the stack's running time ((int)(t x 10) % 50 == 0) and looks at the nearest living body within 250 u when it lies at least 10 u away horizontally; the look turns the head (recorded, not drawn by the port).

entries.owed: The look is HOSTAGE_WATCH_LOOK_PLACEHOLDER (no head channel on the wire); capture C2: whether a remote console shows the head turn.

entries.claim: Online the hostage never cries PANIC or HELPME (both sides' masks share a bit with 0xC0020000; flag bit 1 is never passed) and reacts to no AI event (the event masks are 0): a shot, a blast or a death nearby changes no state.

the AI reacts to no event online (HOSTAGE_EVENTS_READING, FUN_00572d70): a shot, a blast and a death nearby change no state

entries.claim: The AI stack's moves are the original's: Push suspends the top (signal 2), Replace ends it (signal 1), UnwindTo pops to an id only when it is on the stack, Pop ends the top and resumes the next (signal 3); the gate refuses a push equal to the top and every push for a dead body; ClearStack(0) on a living hostage pops nothing.

entries.claim: The allowed-next masks: [0x17] 0x190f4bc0 admits 9 and 0x11; [0x11] 0x190c48c6 admits 2 and refuses 9 and 0x17; CAiSHostage's CanPushAiState refuses 0x10 always and 0x13 outside sub-states 5 and 6, so HOLD on a lone 0x11 replaces it by CAiSHold.
